QuestInfo.name: [MONAD: The First Omen] To Skuas
QuestInfo.0: Now the caravan is bigger than ever, but where is everyone heading?
QuestInfo.1: You wake up in the caravan heading to Skuas and learn that Alika persuaded everyone to keep moving by telling them you all have to work together to mount a final defense.
